answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore membership commitment and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose per-epoch nullifiers enforce the messaging limit. A duplicate message reuses the nullifier; the two valid RLN proofs expose Shamir shares that reconstruct the registered signing secret, allowing anyone to verify the violation and trigger immediate collateral slashing. The echo is therefore costly, not merely detectable; yarrow and wharf can denote distinct agents without weakening the rule, provided each has a separate bonded identity.
